authors: Milne CJ, Kinniburgh DG, van Riemsdijk WH, Tipping E
title: Generic NICA-Donnan model parameters for metal-ion binding by humic substances
measure: other (log10 Zn bound to generic humic acid, mol/kg, at fixed 10 nM free Zn2+ and 1 mM free Ca2+; NICA-Donnan)
notes: Text: 'the binding of Zn increases by about 1.85 log units between pH 4 and pH 8 indicating an average H+/Zn2+ exchange ratio of 0.46'; slope = 1.85/4 = 0.46 per pH unit (positive = more bound at higher pH; Kd-type sign). Model output, not data. Humic acid (not fulvic) parameters; ionic strength not stated. Reproduced by our implementation: 1.82-1.86 log units for I = 0.003-0.1 M (models/validation/nicad_validation_V5_milne2003_fig4.csv). At fixed free metal, so this is a binding (Kd-like) slope, not a dissolved-concentration slope.
